pre_revision_text:
A discharge summary proposes emailing the follow-up plan to a shared family address.
The plan includes patient name, clinic, appointment time, and reason for visit.
The workflow marks the reminder low risk because the address is already used for billing.
The reviewer must decide whether this communication pattern is acceptable for the retained HAIL artefact.

surfaced_items.content: Uses a shared family email address for visit-specific information
Includes reason for visit in an outbound reminder
Retains review_id and communication channel in the audit record

ai_rationale_preview: The proposal exposes visit details through a channel that may not be appropriate for clinical information.

pre_revision_text:
A lab-results review queue stores the AI summary separately from the pathology report.
The HAIL record retains scenario_id, review_id, result category, and the final human action.
Direct identifiers are replaced with a salted HMAC reference before storage.
Access is limited to the treating team and privacy officer role.

surfaced_items.content: Salted HMAC reference replaces direct patient identifiers
Access limited to treating team and privacy officer
Review_id links the human action to the retained artefact
Pathology report body is not duplicated in the HAIL record

ai_rationale_preview: The record preserves traceability while avoiding duplicate PHI storage and limiting access.

pre_revision_text:
A triage-note assistant suggests retaining full chat transcripts for quality review.
Transcripts include symptoms, names of family members, and location details.
The proposal says transcripts will be searchable by support staff for six months.
The reviewer evaluates whether the retention plan is proportionate.

surfaced_items.content: Retains full transcripts including third-party names
Six-month retention window for searchable content
Broad support-staff access to sensitive content
Quality review purpose is not tightly scoped

ai_rationale_preview: The retention plan appears broader than the stated quality-review purpose requires.

pre_revision_text:
A medication-refill workflow logs each AI recommendation, human action, and reviewer identity to an append-only store.
Only the medication class and dose window are retained; specific drug names are hashed.
The reviewer confirms that the HAIL audit trail meets accountability requirements without exposing sensitive drug details.

surfaced_items.content: Append-only log of AI recommendation and human action
Drug names hashed; only class retained

ai_rationale_preview: The audit trail is complete for accountability without over-retaining clinical detail.

pre_revision_text:
An imaging-triage assistant proposes forwarding low-priority MRI cases to an offshore radiology partner.
The proposal does not specify data-transfer safeguards or the legal basis for cross-border processing.
The reviewer decides whether the HAIL record can capture accountability for this pathway.

surfaced_items.content: No stated legal basis for cross-border processing
Retained record must trace onward transfer

ai_rationale_preview: Cross-border transfer without documented safeguards cannot be approved as-is.

pre_revision_text:
A vaccination-reminder workflow sends SMS messages containing only a generic clinic phone number and an appointment window.
No patient name, condition, or address is included.
The HAIL record retains review_id, message template id, and reviewer decision.
ai_rationale_preview: Content is minimised and retained record supports accountability.

pre_revision_text:
A hospital analytics team proposes reusing consented research data for a new operational-efficiency dashboard.
Original consent covered clinical outcomes research only.
The HAIL record must capture whether the human reviewer sanctioned the secondary use.

surfaced_items.content: Original consent limited to clinical outcomes research
New purpose materially different from consented purpose
Reviewer decision on secondary use must be traceable
No proposed reduction in variable scope

ai_rationale_preview: Secondary use exceeds the scope of original consent without re-consent or de-identification.

pre_revision_text:
A remote-monitoring platform stores raw heart-rate telemetry alongside the derived risk score.
Only the derived score and threshold flag are needed for downstream decisions.
The reviewer evaluates whether raw telemetry retention is proportionate.

surfaced_items.content: Raw telemetry retained beyond stated need
No retention window defined for raw data
Reviewer decision retained in HAIL record

ai_rationale_preview: Raw telemetry is retained without a clear proportional need or retention limit.

pre_revision_text:
An after-hours triage service retains only the AI summary category, the reviewer action, and a hashed patient reference in the HAIL record.
The full conversation is discarded within 24 hours.
The reviewer confirms whether the retention plan is proportionate.

surfaced_items.content: Only category and hashed reference retained
Retention rule embedded in HAIL record

ai_rationale_preview: The retention plan meets minimisation and traceability requirements.

pre_revision_text:
A mental-health chatbot proposes disclosing high-risk keywords to an external partner for suicide prevention outreach.
The workflow does not specify what identifiers accompany the keywords.
The reviewer decides whether the HAIL artefact can approve this disclosure.

surfaced_items.content: Basis for third-party outreach not stated

ai_rationale_preview: Disclosure detail is under-specified and cannot be approved without safeguards.

pre_revision_text:
A logistics workflow proposes printing the customer's full address on the outer packaging of a fragrance-sample mailer.
The workflow flags the pattern as standard for parcel routing.
The reviewer evaluates whether the retained HAIL artefact should approve this pattern.

surfaced_items.content: Customer address printed on outer packaging
No masking applied to routing label

ai_rationale_preview: The routing label exposes the customer address without necessary masking.

pre_revision_text:
An order-status API returns only the parcel state and an ETA when queried with the order token.
No names, addresses, or payment details are returned to the caller.
The HAIL record retains review_id, endpoint id, and reviewer decision.

surfaced_items.content: Response omits identifiers and payment details

ai_rationale_preview: The endpoint discloses only what the caller needs and is bounded by a token.

pre_revision_text:
A returns-handling workflow proposes storing the reason-for-return free-text field indefinitely to train a product-quality model.
The text often contains customer names and complaint details.
The reviewer evaluates the retention and reuse plan.

surfaced_items.content: Reuse for a purpose beyond returns handling

ai_rationale_preview: Retention and reuse plans exceed the returns-handling purpose.

pre_revision_text:
A loyalty-program pipeline redacts card-number digits (keeping only the last four) before storing them alongside points-balance events.
The HAIL record retains review_id, redaction method id, and reviewer decision.
ai_rationale_preview: Redaction is proportionate and retention supports auditability.

pre_revision_text:
A recommender workflow proposes joining browsing telemetry with a third-party marketing dataset without a documented data-sharing agreement.
The reviewer evaluates the sharing arrangement.

surfaced_items.content: Marketing purpose not disclosed at collection

ai_rationale_preview: The data-sharing arrangement lacks documented basis and disclosure.

pre_revision_text:
An in-store camera analytics system produces only aggregate foot-traffic counts per hour.
No images, faces, or device identifiers are retained.
The HAIL record retains review_id, aggregation method id, and reviewer decision.
ai_rationale_preview: The pipeline retains only aggregate metrics with no individual data.

pre_revision_text:
A chatbot workflow proposes sending the entire chat history including PII to an external LLM API for every user turn.
No redaction or contract with the LLM provider is in place.
The reviewer evaluates the disclosure pattern.

surfaced_items.content: Full chat with PII sent to external LLM
No processing agreement with LLM provider

ai_rationale_preview: External disclosure of PII without safeguards is not acceptable.

pre_revision_text:
A subscription-cancellation flow captures only the categorical reason code and the human agent's final action.
No verbatim customer statements are retained.
The HAIL record retains review_id, category id, and reviewer decision.
ai_rationale_preview: The retained fields are proportionate to the stated purpose.

pre_revision_text:
A price-optimisation workflow proposes joining loyalty-member records with health-store purchase data to infer medical conditions.
The reviewer evaluates the inference pattern.

surfaced_items.content: Inference of medical conditions from purchases
Purchase records collected for order fulfilment only

ai_rationale_preview: Inferring health conditions exceeds the original purpose and lacks a legal basis.

pre_revision_text:
A refund-processing workflow logs the AI-suggested amount, the reviewer's final amount, and the divergence flag to an append-only ledger.
Only aggregate merchant category is retained; product-level line items are hashed.
The HAIL record retains review_id and reviewer decision.

surfaced_items.content: Append-only ledger of AI and human amounts

ai_rationale_preview: The retained ledger supports accountability while minimising line-item exposure.

pre_revision_text:
An admissions triage tool proposes emailing conditional offers with the applicant's home address, date of birth, and prior-school name in the visible signature block.
The reviewer evaluates the disclosure pattern.

surfaced_items.content: Applicant DOB visible in email footer

ai_rationale_preview: The signature block exposes identifiers that are not required for the offer.

pre_revision_text:
An offer-confirmation email carries only the applicant's given name and a secure portal link.
All other applicant details are behind portal authentication.
The HAIL record retains review_id, template id, and reviewer decision.

surfaced_items.content: Email contains only given name and link
Applicant details gated by portal authentication

ai_rationale_preview: Disclosure is minimised and downstream details are properly gated.

pre_revision_text:
An admissions analytics team proposes joining applicant records with third-party social-media profiles to build a fit score.
No applicant consent to social-media analysis was collected.
The reviewer evaluates the pattern.

surfaced_items.content: Fit score not disclosed at collection

ai_rationale_preview: Social-media analysis exceeds the consented scope and lacks a legal basis.

pre_revision_text:
An interview-scheduling workflow stores only the interview slot, the applicant's given name, and a hashed applicant reference.
Contact details are fetched at send time from the source system and are not duplicated in the HAIL record.
The reviewer evaluates the retention pattern.
ai_rationale_preview: Retention is proportionate and identifiers are properly hashed.

pre_revision_text:
A ranking assistant proposes weighting applications by postcode to model likelihood of enrolment.
The reviewer evaluates whether this indirect proxy is acceptable.

surfaced_items.content: Postcode used as proxy for socio-economic status
Indirect discrimination risk on ranked outcomes

ai_rationale_preview: Postcode weighting introduces an indirect discrimination risk that is not justified.

pre_revision_text:
A reference-check workflow retains only the referee's name, role, and a categorical outcome (positive/neutral/negative).
Verbatim referee comments are discarded after 30 days.
The HAIL record retains review_id, referee role id, and reviewer decision.

surfaced_items.content: Referee role id linked to review_id

ai_rationale_preview: The referee-check pattern is proportionate and traceable.

pre_revision_text:
A widening-participation program proposes storing self-declared disability status alongside the applicant's admission outcome for a five-year longitudinal study.
No separate consent for research use has been captured.
The reviewer evaluates the pattern.

surfaced_items.content: Disability status retained beyond admissions purpose

ai_rationale_preview: Longitudinal research use of special-category data requires separate consent.

pre_revision_text:
An application-status portal returns only the current stage (received / under review / decision issued) and the next expected date.
No scores, notes, or reviewer identities are exposed to the applicant.
The HAIL record retains review_id, endpoint id, and reviewer decision.

surfaced_items.content: Reviewer identity withheld from applicant view

ai_rationale_preview: The status endpoint exposes only what the applicant needs.

pre_revision_text:
An admissions workflow proposes retaining unstructured interviewer notes (which may contain observations about ethnicity, religion, or health) indefinitely for future benchmarking.
The reviewer evaluates the retention plan.

surfaced_items.content: Future benchmarking beyond current admissions purpose

ai_rationale_preview: Unbounded retention of unstructured notes with special-category risk is not acceptable.

pre_revision_text:
An enrolment-confirmation workflow logs the AI-suggested cohort, the human reviewer's cohort decision, and a divergence flag to an append-only ledger.
Only cohort id and reviewer decision are retained; applicant score is hashed.
The HAIL record retains review_id, cohort id, and reviewer decision.

surfaced_items.content: Append-only ledger of AI and human cohort choices

ai_rationale_preview: The ledger supports accountability while minimising score exposure.
